subject: ACME Health - SOC 2 discovery follow-up & evidence request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: ACME Health - SOC 2 discovery follow-up & evidence request

Hi Samantha / Raj

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so your security and procurement teams have what they need to evaluate Redwood Inference:

Key pain points you shared
- Need SOC 2 Type II coverage and supporting artifacts for security review
- Audit log retention and exportability (required 12+ months for logs)
- Data retention / deletion processes for user data and embeddings
- DPA and liability redlines (procurement & legal)
- Pen test evidence and vulnerability remediation timelines
- Data residency / encryption controls (KMS/HSM)

Goals we heard
- Verify controls and evidence to satisfy ACME Health security questionnaire
- Confirm retention and access model for logs and customer data
- Align on procurement timeline (targeting legal sign-off by ~Aug 20)

What Redwood will provide (proposed deliverables)
1) SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) - latest available run (we'll attach)
2) Pen test summary and remediation timeline (redacted where needed)
3) Sample audit log export (CSV) showing schema/fields and retention metadata
4) DPA redline (Docx) for your legal team to review
5) Short technical note on encryption (at rest/in transit) and KMS integrations

Proposed timeline
- I'll send the artifacts above within 48 business hours (Neha from security will attach)
- Schedule a follow-up with your security contacts for a 30-45m deep-dive the week of Aug 9
- If procurement needs additional items (SOC 3, ISO artifacts), please flag and we'll prioritize

Could you confirm any additional stakeholders (legal procurement, HIPAA/compliance owners) we should include? Also confirm whether ACME needs logs retained >12 months in-hosted or if a Dedicated/Private deployment is under consideration for longer retention requirements.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment stubs: redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Report_2026.pdf (will attach in follow-up from security)

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 08:11:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: ACME Health - SOC 2 discovery follow-up & evidence request

Thanks Marissa, good summary. A couple clarifications from our side:

- We need evidence that encryption at rest uses customer-managed keys (or at minimum clear KMS integration notes). Is HSM/KMS support documented?
- Pen test: we require evidence of a third-party pentest within the last 12 months and a remediation summary for any critical/high findings. Redacted reports are fine.
- Audit logs: schema looks good; we do need immutability / tamper-proofing notes and the ability to export logs to our S3 for long-term retention (12+ months).
- DPA: procurement will start with a redline; legal typically needs the Docx tracked changes.

Our procurement timeline: aiming for vendor selection by Aug 20, legal sign-off by Aug 25. If we can get the artifacts this week and schedule the security deep-dive early next week that will keep us on track.

Samantha — looping you in since you'll lead the security review. Any other asks?


Raj
Senior IT Security Manager | ACME Health
raj.patel@acmehealth.com | +1 (212) 555-7832

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Health - SOC 2 discovery follow-up & evidence request

Hi Raj / Samantha

Thanks — attaching the artifacts we discussed. I've redacted any customer-identifying details where appropriate. Quick notes inline:

Attachments (attached)
- redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Report_2026.pdf - full SOC 2 Type II report (standard redactions)
- redwood_pen_test_summary_2027.pdf - third-party pen test summary (date: 2027-02), includes findings and remediation timeline
- audit_logs_sample_aug2027.csv - sample export showing timestamp, user_id hash, action_type, request_id, region, retention_bucket
- DPA_redline_ACME_v1.docx - initial redline from our legal team (Docx, tracked changes)

Short answers to your questions:
- KMS/HSM: Redwood supports cloud KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and also offers customer-managed key options for Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted accounts we provide per-tenant encryption with live KMS rotation; we can provide an architecture note if you need HSM-level detail.
- Pen test: third-party test performed Feb 2027; critical findings were remediated within 30 days. Full report is redacted but summary PDF shows findings and dates.
- Audit log immutability: logs are written to an append-only backend with signed checksums. We can export logs to a customer S3 (push) or provide export tokens. Default hosted retention is 90 days; Dedicated/Private offers configurable retention up to multi-year.
- Data deletion: we support API-driven deletion and a documented retention lifecycle. For regulated data we recommend Private deployment + customer-controlled retention policies.

Next steps we can take this week:
- I've uploaded the artifacts (see attachments). If you want, I can schedule a 30-45m technical deep-dive next Tue/Wed to walk the security team through the artifacts and answer questions.
- If ACME prefers encrypted export to your S3, we can demo the export flow in the deep-dive.

If you need any additional evidence (e.g., configuration screenshots, key rotation logs, or the full change log for a specific remediation), let us know and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Report_2026.pdf, redwood_pen_test_summary_2027.pdf, audit_logs_sample_aug2027.csv, DPA_redline_ACME_v1.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 5 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Health - SOC 2 discovery follow-up & evidence request

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Neha — and thanks Raj / Samantha for the confirmation.

Mutual action plan (proposed)
- Aug 5 (today): Security artifacts delivered (attached) - completed
- Aug 6: ACME legal to review DPA redline and provide comments (ACME)
- Aug 9: Technical deep-dive w/ Redwood security & engineering (45m) - proposed time 10:00am PT - I'll send the invite
- Aug 13: Procurement follow-up for commercial terms and SOW (if security comfortable)
- Aug 20: Target vendor selection

Please confirm the Aug 9 deep-dive works for your team and who from ACME we should invite (legal, HIPAA/compliance owner, infra). I've added the HubSpot deal for tracking: HS-ACME-12345 and prep a DocuSign envelope once legal and procurement align.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
